notes.title: Patch 1.1.03
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

In addition to some minor fixes and improvements, we've been working on a way to speed up the early stages of KILLBUG for our high-scoring players, and we're super keen to finally be sharing it with you all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43950927/4fe41b1d40e2f141da8f072fafe46ca10d35aa14.jpg[/img]

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added gamepad acceleration settings.
[*] Added gamepad aim assist.
[*] Added Taunt system that unlocks for players who have reached 100K points. Hit 'T' (or gamepad west) to accelerate the game and smash out those early waves faster! 
[/list]
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed bad reverb zones.
[*] Fixed bad distance compare on the blood shot causing some bad targeting.
[*] Fixed rotation of sword in main menu.
[*] Fixed flipped Steam Deck pause button.
[*] Disabled alt enter so it won't conflict with saved settings.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.1.02
notes.content:
[b]A massive thank you to everyone submitting bug reports [url=https://discord.gg/samuraipunk]in our Discord server![/url] 

We've made some more fixes and refined the Ground Smash a bit.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43950927/5fe25bfbaaf34845b2996bb4aadbfe15260c8d9d.png[/img]

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved the reliability of Ground Smash from higher heights and added an additional hit test when the VFX are spawned
[/list]
[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where the Tapeworm could spawn immortal
[*] Fixed bug where sounds would eventually stop in long play sessions
[*] Fixed Larva Hive sludge missing a proper death message
[*] Fixed issue where the Ground Smash VFX would play late 
[/list]

[h3][b]KILLBUG is also officially verified on Steam Deck![/b][/h3]

Now you can enjoy all the bug-killing action wherever you want. Go outside and be one with the bugs. <3

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43950927/8a81a5eeed39a16981ddaeebf050bc1426d7eff9.jpg[/img]

Much Love,
Samurai Punk

notes.title: Blood for the Deceiver - Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43950927/0680b9028efada7423ee33d794074c468ed2cdba.png[/img]

[h2][b]The Blood for the Deceiver update is here![/b][/h2]

The team has been working hard to bring you as many player-requested features as possible, along with plenty of new secrets to uncover, so we're SUPER excited for everyone to try this update.

Thank you for supporting KILLBUG so far! If you wanna chat with other players, and the Spunk devs, [url=https://discord.gg/samuraipunk]jump into our Discord server![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43950927/ddb6f88a9f769a38bd88e6db38f8b6ba77728c11.png[/img]
[b][h2]Features[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] Version increased from 1.0.02 > 1.1.00
[*] Added new late game enemies
[*] Added 29 Steam achievements
[*] Added full controller and mouse and keyboard rebinding, accessible via the 'Control' tab in the options
[*] Added option to use a modifier key for melee dash
[*] Added option to enable a simplified crosshair
[*] Added Arachnophobia Mode with two levels of intensity
[*] Added new weapon abilities
[*] Leaderboard UI overhaul
[*] Mini leaderboard added to main menu
[*] Added button to jump to your position on the global leaderboard
[*] Added buttons to jump to top and bottom of leaderboard
[*] Leaderboard can now be smoothly cycled with mouse, keyboard or controller
[*] Leaderboard now handles more languages
[*] Improved Steam Deck support
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43950927/b159a68ce435906f77159f5eebf1c553de4e3aab.png[/img]
[b][h2]Improvements[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] Physics now runs in sync with graphics framerate
[*] Main theme song extended
[*] More lighting variety
[*] New sounds added 
[*] Ambient audio and reverb added to map
[*] Tutorial received some polish 
[*] Made VFX for some enemies more custom to reflect their visual style
[/list]
[b][h2]Balance[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] Tapeworms will now retaliate if you stay still for too long while on their backs
[*] Larva Hives now move to avoid the player when they get very close
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43950927/4a45e5a7d483bb5397e1651a58de8326fb4e571b.jpg[/img]
[b][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where Demon Shot would be active but the visual would disappear
[*] Fixed issue where healing UI can get stuck on if you take damage immediately after healing
[*] Fixed FOV popping when the game starts up if using non-default settings
[*] Fixed rare bug where melee visual wouldn’t swing but damage would still apply
[*] Fixed bug where centipede head would get deflect flash stuck on after respawn
[/list]

[b][h2]No Leaderboard Wipe?[/h2][/b]
After thorough testing, we decided not to wipe the existing leaderboards, as new scores are higher than before, overall.

notes.title: Blood for the Deceiver - A FREE content update coming on June 19th!
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

First of all, we’d like to give a massive thank you to everyone who has supported KILLBUG so far! The top players are NOT messing around and it’s incredible to see. (You’re so much better than us and we’re totally not salty about it.)

[h3][b]We’re releasing a FREE content update! [/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43950927/0680b9028efada7423ee33d794074c468ed2cdba.png[/img]

[h3]The [b]Blood for the Deceiver[/b] update will be available on [b]June 19th, PDT.[/b][/h3]

We can't share too many details right now, but the wait is almost over. In addition to the Steam achievements and input rebinding that heaps of you have been asking for, there's a BUNCH of fun stuff coming in this update.

We’ll be streaming a launch event in our Discord server on June 19th, 4pm PDT, so tune in if you’re keen to check out the new update, see old KILLBUG development builds, and ask the devs some questions!

[url=https://discord.gg/samuraipunk]Join our Discord to party with us![/url]

We hope you're all as keen for the update as we are.

Much Love,
Samurai Punk
<3

tags.feature: - In addition to the Steam achievements and input rebinding that heaps of you have been asking for, there's a BUNCH of fun stuff coming in this update.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.02
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43950927/0e604df0851a6875713e9c81b1276f6365642161.png[/img]

Nick from Samurai Punk here.

We've pushed another small update resolving a few issues people have found since launch. I want to thank everyone for reporting bugs and for sending feedback. 

I also wanted to address some questions people had about the game's future. We can confirm we're working on new things for KILLBUG! First off [b]input rebinding[/b] and [b]achievements[/b] are both on their way. As for the core gameplay we're developing some secret stuff that will release in the same update.

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed issue where using melee immediately after coming off cooldown would not apply damage
[*]Fixed issue where all options in a tab would be non-interactable when opening the options menu sometimes
[*]Fixed issue where applying option changes would cause the screen to refresh if you'd previously changed resolution or fullscreen settings this session
[*]Simplified resolution and fullscreen choices
[*]Speculative fix for brightness being very low on HDR enabled monitors
[*]Fixed colour of Xbox A and B buttons being backwards
[/list]

Much Love,
Samurai Punk 
<3

notes.title: Patch 1.0.01
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43950927/ba219b98b57bb8308f3385d68858f28d9a7dd6ed.png[/img]

[b]Hey everybody![/b]

It's Nick here. First off, I'd just like to say a heartfelt thanks to everyone who's played, set high scores, reviewed the game and shared it on socials. It's really great to see the game clicking with people. 

From myself and everyone here at Samurai Punk, thank you!

It's coming up to the weekend for us but we wanted to put out a little hotfix to resolve some small issues. We've been reading feedback and bug reports, and looking at what to prioritise next, as well as tackling outstanding things we want to improve. 

If you're enjoying KILLBUG, please consider leaving a review. They really help our visibility, and we'd massively appreciate the support!

[h3]Patch 1.0.01 Contents[/h3]
[list]
[*]Transition from the leaderboard to menu should have a cleaner audio cut
[*]Fixed Demon Shot not being able to be fired with zero ammo
[*]Fixed enemy distance FX appearing right on round start
[*]Minor optimisation to seeking projectiles
[/list]

notes.title: KILLBUG is crawling onto Steam on May 3rd!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43950927/dbd4fa9922753325aefcb9003853841e2bb0f4f0.png[/img]

[h2]Blade and barrel hungry for blood. [/h2]

[h2]Thirsty for the sweet nectar of revenge.[/h2]


[b]Hey everyone![/b]

Community Manager Liv here! I’m keen as a bee-n, (sorry), to be announcing what the Samurai Punk team has been cooking up for you all over the past few months!

After we released JUSTICE SUCKS, Nick started working on a side project prototype for a super cool bug FPS that he dubbed “A Bug’s Death”. After a few months of work, he got us all onboard to bring it to its final form, and [b]KILLBUG[/b] was thrust from the womb of game development! 🐞

[b]Now it’s getting ready to crawl onto Steam on May 3rd (PDT) / May 4th (AEST)![/b]

(See how “crawl” worked as a bug joke and a baby joke? There are layers here, people.)

[previewyoutube=oMi3ry2pQpE;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]KILLBUG[/b] is a fast-paced, first-person movement shooter set in an endless arena. Slash and shoot your way through hordes of ravenous insects, mastering fluid aerial movement mechanics as you fight for glory on the leaderboards. 🐝
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43950927/77a0e67fdcd25ff68547323a218140e718118cd5.gif[/img]
[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Battle a wide variety of savage insects.
[*] Destroy hundreds of bugs in fast-paced, brutal combat.
[*] Slash and shoot enemies with your blade and SMG.
[*] Utilize aerial movement mechanics to double-jump, melee-dash, gun-hover and more, quickly adapting to combat different enemy attacks.
[*] Sweat out a new high score on the global leaderboards, or compete to knock your friends off the top spot.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43950927/4fd2ad532256bae3044b9950ae323e46d375e600.gif[/img]
We’ll be streaming the game + hosting a Q&A in a Discord stage event on release day, so join our Discord server to be a part of that! ❤️

Follow all our social shenanigans:
[url=https://twitter.com/samuraipunk]Twitter[/url]
[url=https://www.tiktok.com/@samurai_punk]TikTok[/url]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/@SamuraiPunk]YouTube[/url]
